links.outcome: Caregivers' agreement that received training prepared them to use AI at work
links.effect: Mean agreement was 1.85 (low) for training preparing them to use AI, despite high openness to learning (M = 4.13); self-rated AI readiness was 3.23.
links.quote: A prominent training gap was identified ("the training I received prepared me to use AI at work," M = 1.85), despite high openness to learning (M = 4.13).

screen.reason: Cross-sectional survey of PICU caregivers assessing their perceptions, ethical concerns, readiness, and implementation intentions regarding AI implementation.
